description: Search products and travel eSIM data plans at Dutch partner shops. Returns products (one entry per product, not per shop) with the lowest total price incl. shipping, the cheapest shop, how many shops sell it and whether any shop delivers next day. Use compare_prices with product_key to see every shop for one product.

max_delivery_days.description: Only offers the shop promises within this many working days. 1 = next day ("morgen in huis").

query.description: What to find, in Dutch or English, e.g. "philips airfryer xxl", "sony noise cancelling koptelefoon", "esim japan 10 dagen".

sort.description: Sort: relevance (default), price_low, price_high, fastest, most_shops.

name: search_products
title: Search products
